# authwise_guard_trusted_issuer_rule (Resource)

A rule of a Guard trusted issuer: a machine holding a token the issuer signed for `subject` may join the network with it. `subject` is the token's `sub` claim, matched exactly: there are no patterns, so no neighbouring subject joins on it. One rule per subject in an issuer. The node is named `<node_name_prefix>-<display name>`, the display name the machine sends when it joins; with `node_name_prefix` unset, the issuer's `display_name` as a DNS label is the prefix, so a name repeated across issuers says which issuer joined it. It is added to `node_group`, and counts against `max_nodes` (1 to 1000; unset is 100). `ephemeral` removes a node once it has been offline an hour, or as soon as it leaves the network. Changes apply to joins from now on; joined nodes keep what they joined with. Changing `subject` replaces the rule. Deleting a rule stops further joins; joined nodes stay.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The deploy runners join as ephemeral nodes of the runners' group: each
# holds a token the issuer signed with sub "deploy-runner".
resource "authwise_guard_trusted_issuer_rule" "deploy" {
  tenant_id         = "t-01"
  network_id        = authwise_guard_network.office.guard_network_id
  trusted_issuer_id = authwise_guard_trusted_issuer.build.guard_trusted_issuer_id
  subject           = "deploy-runner"
  node_name_prefix  = "deploy"
  ephemeral         = true
  node_group        = authwise_guard_node_group.runners.name
  max_nodes         = 10
}

# A second subject is a second rule: subjects are matched exactly.
resource "authwise_guard_trusted_issuer_rule" "backup" {
  tenant_id         = "t-01"
  network_id        = authwise_guard_network.office.guard_network_id
  trusted_issuer_id = authwise_guard_trusted_issuer.build.guard_trusted_issuer_id
  subject           = "backup-agent"
  node_name_prefix  = "backup"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (String) The network's id, `authwise_guard_network.<name>.guard_network_id`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `subject` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String) The kit tenant's id (`t-…`) the Guard row belongs to. Guard has no tenant of its own since the tenant collapse (tf#65). The provider's `tenant_id` is not used. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `trusted_issuer_id` (String) The trusted issuer's id, `authwise_guard_trusted_issuer.<name>.guard_trusted_issuer_id`. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `ephemeral` (Boolean)
- `max_nodes` (Number)
- `node_group` (String)
- `node_name_prefix` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) `created_at` as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `created_by` (String)
- `guard_trusted_issuer_rule_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `name` (String) Full resource name; serves as the Terraform ID.
- `node_count` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the rule's full name.
terraform import authwise_guard_trusted_issuer_rule.deploy tenants/t-01/networks/n-01/trustedIssuers/ti-01/rules/tir-01
```
